description: This file contains extension methods for setting up Azure Blob Storage as grain storage in Orleans' silo builder. It provides methods to configure default or named blob storage, with options to configure via options or options builder.

classes.name: AzureBlobSiloBuilderExtensions
classes.description: Static class providing extension methods for configuring Azure Blob Storage as grain storage within the Orleans silo builder.

methods.name: AddAzureBlobGrainStorageAsDefault
methods.description: Configures the silo to use Azure Blob Storage as the default grain storage, with options specified via an action.

methods.name: AddAzureBlobGrainStorage
methods.description: Configures Azure Blob Storage for grain storage with a specific name, options provided via an action.

methods.name: AddAzureBlobGrainStorageAsDefault (overload)
methods.description: Configures the silo to use Azure Blob Storage as the default grain storage, with options specified via an options builder.

methods.name: AddAzureBlobGrainStorage (overload)
methods.description: Configures Azure Blob Storage for grain storage with a specific name, options provided via an options builder.
